observations.behavior: The Salesforce authentication token refresh implementation now treats HTTP 5xx status codes and Salesforce's transient token request errors as transient failures, allowing the refresh to retry rather than immediately raising an error.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures during Salesforce API maintenance or outages, allowing the warehouse connector to recover and complete the token refresh and subsequent data ingestion. This is relevant to warehouse ingestion and reliability.
